newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin rises further on foreign demand, LME.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin rises further on foreign demand, LME.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rallied another five cents to finish at 14.15 ringgit ($5.38) a kg with a firmer London market attracting more foreign demand.

"London's sentiment remained firm last night and Kuala Lumpur also followed suit," a trader said. "There were more buying particularly from Japan with others coming from Malaysia and Europe." There was an initial opening bid of 321 tonnes against offer of 153 tonnes. But final volume was 197 tonnes, compared with 231 tonnes on Thursday. The local price over London was at a $15 a tonne discount against discount $35 on Thursday. --Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.6285 rgt)
